snippet.title: Entrotria Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Entrotria on Steam to get a reminder when the game comes out!
Entrotria is a turn-based space 4X-strategy game with distinguish resource management, asymmetric species design and a chaotic warfare in a dynamic galaxy.
